title: N-finally-return: one live return-inside-finally seam and no class barrier beyond the single nightly_ha pin
claim: An AST walk of all 1069 .py files in the export finds 1 jump escaping a finally (dev/archive/handoff/r9-f2-solver-4/mutation_proof.py:224, which returns 2 from the restore finally and so discards a KeyboardInterrupt or runner exception in flight from sh()), re-finds the R9 D7-s3-51 seam at 957f4a1ed7^ (tests/nightly_ha.py:1274), and the only shipped guard is tests/entities.py's behavioural pin of that one function.
mechanism: A return/break/continue in a finally body replaces the in-flight exception (PEP 765); CPython 3.14 only emits a SyntaxWarning at compile, which a cached .pyc or a warnings filter hides, and no lint lane makes it an error.

evidence.contention_note: two other D14 seats on the box; the count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tests/nightly_ha.py:_async_check_a4 (re-found at 957f4a1ed7^) and every ast.Try.finalbody in the tree; runtime arm drives an in-flight asyncio.CancelledError through the re-introduced shape

perturbation.change: --reintroduce: a one-line `return None` inserted in memory at the first finally of custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py (line 1942)

null_control.value: runtime_swallowed_control=0; custom_components/ and tests/ contribute 0 seams
null_control.note: a finally without a jump lets CancelledError propagate

metric_definition: count of Return nodes, or Break/Continue whose loop lies outside the finally, inside any try.finalbody (nested defs excluded), over every .py file under the export root
phenomenon_property: No return/break/continue escapes a finally anywhere in the repository; an exception in flight from the try always propagates.
proposed_fix_scope: dev/archive/handoff/r9-f2-solver-4/mutation_proof.py: set a flag in the finally and return after it; barrier: the AST walk (about 1 s over 1069 files, provisional) as a tests/ or tools/policy lint check, or `python -W error::SyntaxWarning -m compileall -f -q` in the lint lane
